GetPresentation: Read presentation info. (GET /slides/{name})

CreateWatermark: Adds a text watermark to each slide of the presentation.
Text watermark can be setup via method arguments or withing Shape DTO for detailed customization.
Both options are applicable simultaneously. (POST /slides/{name}/watermark)

CreateImageWatermark: Adds an image watermark to each slide of the presentation. 
Image can be provided as a part of the form or withing PictureFrame DTO for detailed customization.
Both options are applicable simultaneously. (POST /slides/{name}/watermark/image)
DeleteWatermark: Removes shapes with name "watermark" from the presentation. (DELETE /slides/{name}/watermark/delete)

CreateWatermarkOnline: Adds a text watermark to each slide of the presentation.
Text watermark can be setup via method arguments or withing Shape DTO for detailed customization.
